pet_notes: Compact full-body Japanese bake-danuki lucky spirit. Preserve a rounded plush red-brown raccoon-dog body with cream belly and muzzle, dark charcoal eye mask and paws, large green almond eyes, petite pointed ears, a broad woven straw hat with a polished gold crescent ornament, a purple braided cord sash with gold braid and crescent tassel, a cream ceramic moon-marked flask held in one paw, and an attached parchment promissory scroll held in the other. The scroll may use an abstract red-and-gold crescent seal but no readable text. Keep the warm premium painterly mascot style, calm clever friendly smile, giant curled dark-tipped tail, and full readable silhouette.
style_notes: Warm premium painterly mascot rendering from the reference, clean separable full-body sprite, preserve material hierarchy of plush fur, woven straw, parchment, ceramic, purple cord and polished gold. Simplify surface detail only where needed for 60px recognition. No text, logos, detached particles, shadows, scenery, floor marks, or glow.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `auto`: Infer the most appropriate pet-safe style from the user request and reference images, then keep that exact style consistent across every row. User style notes: Warm premium painterly mascot rendering from the reference, clean separable full-body sprite, preserve material hierarchy of plush fur, woven straw, parchment, ceramic, purple cord and polished gold. Simplify surface detail only where needed for 60px recognition. No text, logos, detached particles, shadows, scenery, floor marks, or glow..
pet_safe_style: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction.

visual_decisions.identity: Rounded red-brown bake-danuki with cream muzzle and belly, charcoal eye mask and paws, green almond eyes, ringed tail, woven straw hat, gold crescent, purple-and-gold cord, parchment promissory scroll, and moon flask.
visual_decisions.small_size_priority: Green eyes, dark mask, rounded tanuki silhouette, straw crescent hat, ringed tail, parchment scroll, and moon flask stay readable at 60px.
visual_decisions.prop_policy: The scroll remains attached and uses only an abstract crescent seal with no readable text; flask, cord, tassel, hat crescent, and tail remain attached.
visual_decisions.running_left: Independently generated because mirroring would invert the asymmetric scroll, flask, crescent ornament, and cord handedness.
visual_decisions.look_mechanics: Planted lower body, physical whole-eye and muzzle turns, subtle worn-hat/brim follow-through, attached scroll/flask lag, and small tail counterbalance; no whole-sprite rotation.
